text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year's Twinkle Series is also generating tremendous excitement.
At the core of it all lies—

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that show!?
I'm... grrr, suuuper frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
<nickname> can definitely
win overseas!
...That's why I studied up, you know.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
And then... wow, it sounded tough!
First off, running overseas means a completely different environment.

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text: Right, right! Traveling overseas is a huge deal to begin with, and managing condition is super tough too...

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Right... I watched old footage too, and it said
that even the cool Speed Symboli-san
went on a European campaign—

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
âI saw it, I saw it! Looked up the race records, too!
It was super revolutionary back then, right?
And the expectations were crazy high, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I failed, didn't I?
Plenty of others debuted after that and got great results, but..."

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... Didn't reach the summit, huh...
...Still, even so!
I know how hard it is... but even so!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
—I want them to win!
Our Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The shift in public sentiment had become a hot topic among the Trainers as well.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: My relatives never cared about racing at all... but they reached out to me the other day, saying, 'Show 'em what Japan's made of!'

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I told them not everyone's meant to take on the world, but it still feels great to have people expecting big things from you.
Plus, it looks like they're watching the Twinkle Series too!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the Umamusume are
all fired up as well."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Meek gave a peace sign too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to overseas challenges, Speed Symboli naturally knows best.
I want to accelerate this current excitement even further...!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun.
—You too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to visit... Speed Symboli
was surrounded by a large crowd of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Could you please impart to us the knowledge we need to compete overseas?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, the more information you have,
the better off you are, you know~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Speed Symboli.
The answer was always on the turf, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If we, who follow in your footsteps,
can reach the pinnacle of the world..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That is equal to what you yourself... no, what all of us together have achieved up to now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It is something only we, living in this era, can achieve. ...Please, teach us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How to fight on the world stage.
What we need to get there!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone.
That "someday"—truly was right here.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall I tell you
a little story from the past?"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This might take a while.
—How about some tea?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Throughout our long racing history... you all know
that many renowned Umamusume have taken on the world.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Within the Symboli family, the choice first fell upon me.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just before that, an international sports tournament
held in Japan had achieved tremendous success, you see.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It was a time when public expectations were rising
that Japan, too, could beat the world.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
To answer everyone's passion,
I embarked on a long-term overseas campaign—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it was around this time that the view
of Umamusume as athletes finally started to take solid hold.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Upon departure, we received immense support and cheers from race officials and fans alike.

text_block_list.name: Racing Officials
text_block_list.text: "Speed Symboli~~!! Keep goingーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Rudolf of That Time
text_block_list.text:
"Su-san! Please take care of yourself!
Be sure to go out there and show them your majesty!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I was especially touched
by the lovely send-off from the juniors.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* Back then, you were shining
so brilliantly... you were arguably
the strongest in the entire nation.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I, too, had at least some pride
as a representative of Japan... and yet.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —The overseas campaign proved to be truly grueling.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A sudden change in environment...
Continuous races without time to adjust...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That was back when we knew far less about overseas expeditions.
I lost so much weight that my uniform became loose on me.
choice_data_list: To think it was that harsh...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"No, what was truly brutal was...
the 'reality' that shattered the illusion, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
As you all know,
I suffered a crushing defeat in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Haa... hah...!
Dammit... this can't be...!
This wasn't supposed to...—Dammiiiit!!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Elevation changes unlike anything experienced in Japan, turf that catches your legs, and the pressure of the world's top-tier Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! Don't go!! Wait...!
No, wait...! Aaaaaahhh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
――"Japanese Umamusume can never win."
That was the reality.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...However!
That reality—is in the past now.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"We learned.
And so, from there, we began."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Raise the level of Umamusume across the board,
and change the domestic perception of the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Without reform, we can't stand at the top of the world.
That realization was the greatest takeaway I brought back with me.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Allow me to answer once more.
What does it take to conquer the world?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it is strength. Power that yields to none...
However, what I wish to say above all else is—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's about all of Japan uniting as one
to aim for the very top.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The reason I was able to fight on and never give up during those grueling days...
was because there were people supporting me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: "I'm calling the local experts right now. We'll definitely pull through this together. I won't let it end for you in a place like this..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text: "Speed Symboli! Don't give up! Show them your greatness... your power!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text:
"Su-chan, it's okay.
They're looking for medicine to bring down your fever right now.
Hang in there...! I'm right here with you...!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Their voices, their hands... their believing gazes.
They truly gave me strength.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Uniting all our hopes as one...
we stood together, learned, and gained experience.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Wounded... and losing comrades along the way...
Refusing to give up, pressing forward continuously—and then.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I've finally reached you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You stand upon the continuous path of hoofprints leading up to this moment—
and because of that, you are stronger than any in the past.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"It is time for the challenger to spark a revolution.
The power to claim the world... is already in those hands!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, the Umamusume pondered over
Speed Symboli's concluding words—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the next day on, the atmosphere around
Tracen Academy shifted slightly once again...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Then, let us begin the discussion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What is the most effective way
to adapt to European racetracks?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I want each of you to voice your thoughts without hesitation. First of all..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pearl-san!
Let's run together, desu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's compete to see who sets a record first! Let us battle!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes!
Let's dance battle now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! Not a dance!
It's a race, a race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing the Umamusume fight so hard to push even further ahead... As a Trainer, it truly struck a chord in my heart.
choice_data_list: (I've got to let the fans know about this too!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking so, while I was filming a video
to upload to social media...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Speed Symboli gazed deeply moved at the Umamusume giving their all.
choice_data_list: Everyone's really fired up, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's beautiful.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Still, those spirited expressions
on everyone's faces...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: It is truly, remarkably beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, St Lite said the same...
looking at the Umamusume, and Haiseiko called them stars as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why are the legends able to look so directly at the next generation, watch over them...
and purely entrust their dreams to them...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea how to even ask.
Perhaps it was something only fellow Umamusume could truly understand. But still—
choice_data_list: You really believe in them, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: The future is sure to be something wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You are too,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm here right now.
Living my dream."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Connecting the past and the future.
Hand in hand... with us.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Let's turn the world
upside down."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text:
Dad, look!
An amazing video was uploaded!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume are giving it their all to take on the world...
The Twinkle Series is so thrilling right now!
Look, see for yourself!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's amazing!
I see, so this is the kind of era we live in now...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
...I have to move forward from the past.
Into the future...――
